summary.business_type: Professional services — custom software development agency (Nairobi, KE; serving Africa/worldwide)
top_findings: Cost blog post contains no prices while pricing.html promises ranges — both fail the cost query
Zero human authorship/E-E-A-T: Organization-only bylines, anonymous team cards, no LinkedIn
Homepage duplicates the entire products grid verbatim (cannibalization)
Meta descriptions missing on 3 pages including the head-term services page (~355 words, thin)
Homepage LCP is an 859 KB uncompressed PNG hero
Head-term services page thin (~355 words) — since expanded to 823
quick_wins: Add KES ranges to the cost post
Convert hero-collage.png and other >300 KB PNGs to WebP/AVIF
Delete 307 orphan legacy images (~27.9 MB) + .DS_Store/.db junk
Add Person authors with LinkedIn sameAs to blog schema

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with 308 redirects (Caddy)
robots.txt with explicit AI-crawler policy; sitemap declared
sitemap.xml exactly matches the 19 public pages; 404 excluded
Unique canonicals on every page
Real HTTP 404 with custom page (no soft-404)
No internal orphan pages; blog posts cross-link contextually
Scripts deferred; single stylesheet

findings.title: www is a live duplicate host
findings.description: https://www.saharasoft.org/ serves 200 with full content; http://www redirects to https://www, never to apex. Only canonical tags dedupe.

findings.title: No security headers
findings.description: No HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or CSP in live response headers.

findings.title: Deploy hygiene
findings.description: 6 .DS_Store and 13 .db files inside images/ are deployed.
findings.recommendation: Purge and add deploy ignore rules.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Verifiable product evidence: 10 named live products with real domains
Consistent NAP on every page; ProfessionalService schema with geo
Local-market specificity AI engines can quote (M-Pesa, water-utility revenue gap)
Water-utility internal-link cluster (blog ↔ case study ↔ pricing)
Dated posts with time elements and datePublished/dateModified

findings.title: Cost post refuses to answer the cost query
findings.description: 'What projects cost in Kenya' section has no numbers; pricing.html promises 'the ranges Kenyan projects typically fall into' in that exact post.
findings.recommendation: Publish real KES bands/tables; target 1,200+ words.

findings.title: No human E-E-A-T
findings.description: All bylines are 'By Saharasoft Solutions'; team grid has no surnames, credentials, or LinkedIn.
findings.recommendation: Named authors with bios + Person schema + LinkedIn sameAs.

findings.title: Anonymized, metric-free flagship case study
findings.description: TallyDue case study: 'Client: A water utility in Kenya', one vague metric, no quote/scale/timeframe; text reused verbatim on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add client identity, hard metrics, quote.

findings.title: Thin money pages
findings.description: services ~355 words for head term; why-invest post ~269 generic words; products hub ~200 (fully duplicated on homepage); case-studies hub ~213.
findings.recommendation: Expand services to 800–1,000 words; fix or fold why-invest.

findings.title: Three cannibalization pairs
findings.description: index↔products (identical grid), index↔services (head intent), pricing↔cost post (same query, no numbers on either).
findings.recommendation: Differentiate intents; homepage shows selected work only.

findings.title: No citable statistics
findings.description: Only numbers site-wide are unsubstantiated '90+/8+/12+' and 'days instead of weeks'.

findings.title: No FAQ sections or FAQPage schema
findings.description: Zero FAQ content despite FAQ-shaped pages (pricing, cost, services).

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles on all 19 pages; exactly 1 H1 per page everywhere
Complete OG (10 tags) + Twitter (4 tags) + favicon + lang=en on all sampled pages

findings.title: Meta descriptions all present (audit correction)
findings.description: Initial audit reported 3 missing descriptions; they exist in multi-line meta tags. Regex corrected.

findings.title: 4 overlong titles
findings.description: 105/86/82/75 chars (water post, mobile-money post, partner post, homepage) will truncate in SERPs.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid JSON-LD on 18/19 pages, zero invalid blocks
Correct type mapping: Organization/WebSite/ProfessionalService, Blog/BlogPosting (dates), Article/CollectionPage, ContactPage, ItemList
ProfessionalService includes geo, areaServed, priceRange

findings.title: Organization-as-author + og-image-as-logo
findings.description: All BlogPosting authors are Organization; publisher logo is the 1200x630 og-image.jpg.

findings.title: Missing FAQPage and BreadcrumbList
findings.description: No FAQ schema anywhere; no breadcrumbs on nested pages.

findings.title: Sparse Organization enrichment
findings.description: sameAs only lists saharasoftsolutions.com; address lacks street/postal code.
findings.recommendation: Add LinkedIn/GitHub sameAs, full address, logo.

categories.name: Performance (CWV, static estimate — no lab data)
what_works: Homepage ~319 KB total (HTML+CSS+JS+12 images, uncompressed)
No render-blocking JS; one stylesheet

findings.title: 859 KB PNG homepage hero (LCP risk)
findings.description: CORRECTED: hero-collage.png was an unreferenced orphan; the site serves hero-collage.webp (73KB). Referenced images total 1.09MB, max 90KB. Issue was deploy bloat, not page weight.

findings.title: No field CWV data
findings.description: Lighthouse/CrUX unavailable in this environment; score is a static estimate.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended
Comprehensive structured llms.txt with products table and key links
Quotable positioning statements with local specificity

findings.title: Staging URLs in llms.txt
findings.description: Lists staging-garage.saharasoft.org, realator.api.saharasoft.org, courier.saharasoft.org — LLM-facing manifest points at non-production hosts.
findings.recommendation: Remove or replace with production URLs.

findings.title: Nothing to cite
findings.description: No statistics, no named authors, cost post withholds the numbers its query demands.
findings.recommendation: Publish concrete figures and named expertise.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero missing or empty alt attributes across all 19 pages
Correct lazy-loading of below-fold galleries; case-study LCP images eager
